description: The file 'EngineSnifferPanel.java' defines a Java Swing component for the engine sniffer UI panel in a vehicle tuning or diagnostic application. It manages display and interaction with engine waveforms, charts, and status indicators, including controls for pausing, saving images, zooming, and chart selection. The class interacts with other components such as EngineChartParser, EngineReport, UpDownImage, and various UI controls.

classes.name: EngineSnifferPanel
classes.description: A Swing panel that visualizes engine waveforms, charts, and status info for engine diagnostics. It provides controls for pausing, saving images, zooming, and chart updates, managing a collection of UpDownImage components representing various engine signals.

methods.name: setPaused
methods.description: Sets the paused state of the engine sniffer, updating button label accordingly.

methods.name: setOutpinListener
methods.description: Registers a callback to update physical pin info on engine state changes.

methods.name: resetImagePanel
methods.description: Removes all images and resets to the primary crank image.

methods.name: displayChart
methods.description: Parses and displays an engine chart, updating images and status indicators.

methods.name: getPanel
methods.description: Returns the main JPanel containing the engine sniffer UI.

methods.name: createSecondaryImage
methods.description: Creates and adds a new UpDownImage component for a given signal name.

methods.name: getInsertIndex
methods.description: Determines insertion index for new images based on name order.

methods.name: saveImage
methods.description: Saves the current UI view as an image with filename based on RPM and MAF sensor value.

methods.name: createImage
methods.description: Creates an UpDownImage with configured color scheme based on the signal name.

methods.name: reloadFile
methods.description: Reloads and displays the default chart.

methods.name: getTabSelectedListener
methods.description: Provides an action listener to focus the chart size command when tab is selected.
